title: Bind Staging Recovery external observations to canonical integrity and protected route evidence

phases.objective: Reject modified, stale, cross-target or secret-bearing observations and keep certification closed until authenticated acquisition exists; bind network denial and Gateway success to the same request.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Verify synthetic external observations and attempt a Staging Recovery canary
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Canonical, short-lived observations can pass structural verification, but canary, countersign, signing and readiness remain closed until PR-B adds authenticated acquisition; Production remains disabled.
steps: Verify kind, contract, provenance identifiers, exact SHA and target, freshness, and canonical hash.
Reject secret fields and modified observations before Kernel execution.
Reject even hash-consistent, source-labeled observations before Kernel execution or countersign while the server-owned acquisition gate is closed.
Verify direct denial reason and status, and bind the same protected path, method, and body digest to signed Gateway success.
Confirm public health reachability is compatible with the isolation contract.
assertions: Source identifiers are structural assertions; authenticated acquisition remains a separate PR-B requirement.
Runtime verification and countersign fail closed on invalid evidence.
Production mutation is prohibited and live Staging certification remains required.
